Title: Some users may be unable to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may be unable to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online.

Current status: We’ve identified a recent update as a potential source of impact and are conducting further analysis to confirm our hypothesis.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact some users attempting to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online due to hitting a recipient limit of 25 users. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online 

User impact: Users may be unable to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online.

More info: Users may be unable to send calendar invitations due to hitting an incorrect recipient limit of 25 users for affected messages.

Current status: We've isolated that a recent service update removed the "MeetingMessage" traffic subtype from affected messages, causing a lower recipient limit of 25 to be applied instead of the standard 5000. We're rolling back the problematic update for all potentially affected users and have updated the "Title", "User impact", and "Scope of impact" fields of our communications to reflect this change. We aim to provide a timeline to remediation as soon as possible.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact some users attempting to send calendar invitations in Exchange Online due to hitting a recipient limit of 25 users. This information may be updated as our investigation continues. 

Start time: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent service update removed the "MeetingMessage" traffic subtype from affected messages, causing a lower recipient limit of 25 to be applied instead of the standard 5000.

Next update by: Thursday, November 26, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
